messages.text: Actually already have one.  Looking at Harlo os
Harlo OS is the firmware on our miners — B30, Magic (address hidden), Thor P2. Firmware and flashing live at harlolabs.com. What are you running it on, and what are you trying to get it to do?

I've got a Thor P2, currently running on Thor os.  I'd like to run Harlo os.  Many reasons, but I like the idea of splitting the hash rate between pools.  Keeping some for solo, and contributing som to a pool

Harlo OS on a Thor P2 is fine — it's one of the units we ship on it. Flashing is at harlolabs.com. But splitting one unit's hashrate across a solo target and a pool at the same time, I won't guess at. Let me get that answered properly.
Handed to the team · Harlo OS multi-pool / hashrate-splitting cap···· not something I can confi

The team has it and someone will jump in here — if you step away you'll get it by email. Meanwhile, what's driving the split: you want steady payouts but don't want to give up the block shot entirely?
exactly, want to try out parasite pool, but don't want to give up my little lottery machine.
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner BC04 Magic Miner 40T

Cleanest way to get both, today: a second box. Keep the Thor P2 solo as your lottery machine and point the new one at Parasite.

The Hammer BC04 is the cheap way in — 6 TH/s, ~100W, $239, in stock and ships in about 5 business days. If you want real weight behind the pool side, the Magic Miner 40T is 40 TH/s at ~650W, $799, ships November 21.

Which way are you leaning?
